title: Fert + Fungicide, Amstel Lawns
last_load: Check what was last in the Bertolini and run clean water through first
site_check: Spray signs out at the Amstel lawns
weather: Wind 3–20 km/h · no heavy rain coming
facts: Bertolini · Yellow · 4–4.5 km/h walking · about 20 psi
ppe_note: GreenMaxx and High K irritate eyes: goggles, PVC gloves and apron when you pour them. Medallion label: cotton overalls buttoned to the neck and wrist.
spray_rules: Amstel lawns, 875 m², one 35 L fill
Walk a steady 4–4.5 km/h at about 20 psi with the yellow nozzles. Keep the overlap even so there are no stripes
Don't leave any product to dry on concrete or paths: hose it off straight away
Wind 3–20 km/h, coarse spray. Don't spray if heavy rain is coming
Keep people off until it's dry. Don't mow or water until it's thoroughly dry, ideally 24 h (Medallion label)
spray_more: 250GT label: agitate thoroughly, check water pH (unstable at pH 7 or above), no surfactants or spray oils, don't mix with fertilisers (urea may cause foliar damage). Medallion label: 3 L/ha in 300–500 L/ha, coarse droplets, wind 3–20 km/h, don't mow or water until dry. High K SDS: pH 12.4–12.8, keep away from strong acids. Shadow Ultra label: add to a tank at least two-thirds full.

flags.d: The 250GT label says not to mix with fertilisers (urea mixtures may cause foliar damage), and iprodione is unstable at pH 7 or above. High K (potassium carbonate, pH 12.4–12.8) lists strong acids as incompatible, and GreenMaxx is pH 2–3 with iron and magnesium sulphate. Built as the sheet (Andy, 10 Nov).
flags.s: 250GT label APVMA 62284 · High K SDS 2025 · GreenMaxx SDS

flags.d: Label rate is 3 L/ha in 300–500 L/ha for leaf and crown disease. 263 mL is the sheet amount for 875 m².
Top of the label's 90–180 mL per 100 m² turf range.
